answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital at risk. Like a willow bending under market pressure, the system maintains stability by tethering identity to financial commitment. An attacker attempting to scale fake nodes must cross the ridge of high capital expenditure to gain consensus influence. Every marginal identity added pushes the adversary closer to the financial ledge where slashing protocols ensure that malicious behavior results in irreversible economic loss.
